reasoning: 本批為 Browse Control（003／004）與 Menu Navigation（008）之解鎖。適用性依 R-ICS2 v2(b) 逐物件實測：`1.8.1.2 {4819577}` 群 **9 物件全適用**（E4 未觸發），`4819555` 判**適用**（E3 未觸發）。自 9 個適用物件中生成 6 條：4819578／4819579 為 Description 型章節引言（無可驗行為）、4819581 為「見 LID 檔」之指向（不可驗）、4819585 為 KNOB1 之音量面（屬 001／002，非本批）—— 四者不生 TC，理由逐一具名。008 生 1 條。切分依 IN §8.2.2 與 §8.3；訊號名依 b03 作業 E 之實測（`Radio_Knob2_DIR`／`_VAL`／`Radio_btn1`，皆 `BO_ 1050`、發送節點 ICS）；`_VAL` 無 `VAL_` 列舉故不加標籤（R-ICS8(d)）。刻意未涵蓋：009（R-ICS15(b)，DR-ICS13 未回）與 005（R-ICS15(c)，DR-ICS1 未回），本批各 0 條；`1.8.1.3` 之按壓事件定義因 `[ECU:FPDM]` 判不適用，構成覆蓋缺口並依下放包 04 §三 C-4 具名，不自他處補。

tcs.test_item:
The ICS shall send the information in a pair of on-change messages using the $ICS_KNOB<n>_DIR$ = [increment or  decrement] and $ICS_KNOB<n>_VAL$ = [1 to 63] signals and values and then within <TPeriodToSendNoChange> seconds send the $ICS_KNOB<n>_DIR$ = [Knob_no_change] and $ICS_KNOB<n>_VAL$ = [0] signals and values
(One detent clock-wise sends the direction and value pair, then returns to no change)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The A&T System has exited SLEEP MODE
2. A CAN trace tool is connected and able to log the ICS knob and button status messages
3. The ICS knob 2 is not being rotated
4. The no-change resend period of the ICS is 20 msec
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Rotate the ICS knob 2 one detent position clock-wise
2. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ and check that it is 1 (Knob_increment)
3. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ and check that it is 1
4. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ 2 seconds after the rotation and check that it is 0 (Knob_no_change)
5. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ 2 seconds after the rotation and check that it is 0
tcs.expected_result:
1. The knob 2 detent is felt and the rotation is completed
2. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ = 1 (Knob_increment) is received
3. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ = 1 is received
4. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ = 0 (Knob_no_change) is received
5. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ = 0 is received
tcs.reasoning: 驗證目標為 4819583 之送出面：轉動一格後，ICS 以一對 on-change 訊息送出方向與值，再於 <TPeriodToSendNoChange> 秒內回到 no change。上半 verbatim **取該物件之第二句**（45 token，未逾 R-3 之 50）—— 此為 IN §4.3.1 之正規摘句（整句），非 R-ICS20 之片段摘取，故無 (c) 之三項限制之適用。第一句（detent 計數與 <TPeriodToCountKnobDetents>）之測試目的另由 B5 承擔。訊號名依 b03 作業 E 實測：`CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR`／`_VAL`（`BO_ 1050`，發送節點 ICS）；DIR 之值逐字取 `VAL_ 1050 Radio_Knob2_DIR 0 "Knob_no_change" 1 "Knob_increment" 2 "Knob_decrement" 3 "Knob_enter";`。**VAL 無 `VAL_` 列舉**（連續量，`SG_ … 29|6@0+ (1,0) [0|63]`），依 R-ICS8(d) 不自造 label，故書 `= 1` 而不加括號標籤。步驟 4／5 取「轉動後 2 秒」為觀察點：<TPeriodToSendNoChange> 無值（CFTS020 為符號），2 秒為測試實作選擇而非規格值，故不宣稱其為 spec 值亦不落佔位；**若上游回覆之 T2 大於 2 秒，本二步須改**，已於 upstream-04 §獨立判斷具名。與另一方向之條分列依 IN §8.3（方向軸）。　【b05 作業 B】依 R-ICS23(b) 增第 4 條 Pre-Condition：步驟 4／5 之「轉動後 2 秒」為測試實作選擇，而 `<TPeriodToSendNoChange>` 於 CFTS020 為符號無值。分析層採認「不影響送什麼、只影響何時觀察」之區分，**但『何時觀察』錯了仍致本條判錯**，故仍須佔位（IN §8.4.3）。寫為系統組態之狀態而非動作（IN §4.4）。　【b07 作業 B】no-change 重送週期之佔位已回填為 **20 msec**，逐字取自 `CFTS020-4819541`（無 `initial value` 之保留字）。**該值遠小於本條步驟 4／5 所用之 2 秒觀察點** —— upstream-04 §10-2-2 所具名之「觀察時點可能錯」之風險，至此實測為**不成立**；2 秒仍為測試實作選擇，非規格值。錨行增 `CFTS020-4819541`。

distinguishing_axis.delta: clock-wise 之方向值；另一方向由 B2 承擔

tcs.test_item:
When a physical knob is not rotated, the ICS shall send the $ICS_KNOB<n>_DIR$ = [no change] signal. For this state, the value of $ICS_KNOB<n>_VAL$ shall be ignored by the receiving components and no action taken on the value
(No change direction is sent and the value is not acted on while the knob is stationary)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The A&T System has exited SLEEP MODE
2. A CAN trace tool is connected and able to log the ICS knob and button status messages
3. The ICS knob 2 is not being rotated
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ and check that it is 0 (Knob_no_change)
2. Keep the ICS knob 2 stationary for 5 seconds
3. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ again and check that it is still 0 (Knob_no_change)
4. Check that the HU screen content is unchanged during the 5 seconds
tcs.expected_result:
1. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ = 0 (Knob_no_change) is received
2. The knob 2 remains stationary
3. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ = 0 (Knob_no_change) is received
4. The HU screen content is unchanged
tcs.reasoning: 驗證目標為 4819582：旋鈕未轉時送 no change，且此狀態下 VAL 之值應被接收端忽略。上半 38 token，二句逐字全取。步驟 4 以「畫面不變」承載「VAL 被忽略」—— 條文之 `ignored by the receiving components` 無直接可觀察之訊號面（忽略是「不做事」），只能由其後果觀察。此為本條驗證強度之弱點，已於 upstream-04 §獨立判斷具名。與 B1／B2 之切分軸為 trigger_state（靜止 vs 轉動）。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 旋鈕靜止；轉動中之送出由 B1／B2 承擔

tcs.test_item:
When the ICS determines no change in the rotation direction or value, the ICS shall send $ICS_KNOB<n>_DIR$ = [no change] and $ICS_KNOB<n>_VAL$ = [0] signals and values at the scheduled periodic rate until the knob is rotated again
(Direction and value stay at no change and zero at the periodic rate until the knob is rotated again)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The A&T System has exited SLEEP MODE
2. A CAN trace tool is connected and able to log the ICS knob and button status messages
3. The ICS knob 2 has just been rotated one detent position clock-wise
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ and check that it is 0 (Knob_no_change)
2. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ and check that it is 0
3. Record the cycle time between two consecutive frames carrying the knob 2 signals
4. Rotate the ICS knob 2 one detent position clock-wise and check that $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ is 1 (Knob_increment)
tcs.expected_result:
1. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ = 0 (Knob_no_change) is received
2. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ = 0 is received
3. The frames carrying the knob 2 signals are received at a constant cycle time
4. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ = 1 (Knob_increment) is received
tcs.reasoning: 驗證目標為 4819584：判定無變化後，DIR = no change 與 VAL = 0 以排定之週期率持續送出，直至旋鈕再次轉動。上半 38 token，單句逐字全取。與 B3（4819582）之別：4819582 治「未轉動時之送出值」，4819584 治「無變化之持續與其終止條件」——二條各自成立之 SFR，其失敗模式不同（前者送錯值；後者不送或不停），依 IN §8.2.2 分列。`scheduled periodic rate` 之具體值 CFTS020 未載，故步驟 3 只記錄週期而不斷言其值 ——斷言一個未載之數即造值（IN §8.4.1）。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 無變化之週期持續與其終止；未轉動時之送出值由 B3 承擔

tcs.tc_title: Three detents counted in one rotation
tcs.test_item:
While a knob is being rotated, the ICS shall count the relative number of detents rotated through in <TPeriodToCountKnobDetents> seconds
(Three detents rotated in one continuous motion are reported as a value of three)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The A&T System has exited SLEEP MODE
2. A CAN trace tool is connected and able to log the ICS knob and button status messages
3. The ICS knob 2 is not being rotated
4. The detent counting time window of the ICS is 50 msec
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ and check that it is 0
2. Rotate the ICS knob 2 three detent positions clock-wise in one continuous rotation
3. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ and check that it is 3
4. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ and check that it is 1 (Knob_increment)
tcs.expected_result:
1. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ = 0 is received
2. The three detents are felt and the rotation is completed
3. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_VAL$ = 3 is received
4. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ = 1 (Knob_increment) is received
tcs.reasoning: 驗證目標為 4819583 之**第一句**：轉動中之 detent 相對計數。上半取該句（20 token）為正規摘句 —— 其與括號下半之測試目的直接相關，第二句之送出形制由 B1／B2 承擔。計數時間窗 `<TPeriodToCountKnobDetents>` 於 CFTS020 為符號無值，依 IN §8.4.3 落 `PENDING: DR-ICS12` 佔位，寫為系統組態之狀態而非動作（IN §4.4）——與 b01 之 V3（knob 1 側之同一問題）同一處置。n = 3 為測試實作選擇，非規格數值。與 B1 之切分軸為 input_data（3 格 vs 1 格），驗證對象亦異（累計計數 vs 單格送出形制）。　【b07 作業 B】detent 計數窗之佔位已回填為 **50 msec**，逐字取自 `CFTS020-4819541`。**該值於原文標 `initial value` 並附 `parameter tuning process` 之註 —— 即其為暫定值，可於整合測試後變更**（R-ICS27(c)）。故 DR-ICS12 **不結案**，改為「請上游確認調校後之定值」之追蹤件；本條之數值面於該定值確認前仍不得視為終局。錨行增 `CFTS020-4819541`。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 一次轉三格之累計計數；單格之送出形制由 B1 承擔

tcs.tc_title: Knob 2 signals acted on by the HU
tcs.test_item:
When the HU receives $ICS_KNOB2_DIR$ and $ICS_KNOB2_VAL$ signals it shall determine the corresponding HMI screen to 'flow' to (Browse), if any, HMI screen to update (Scroll) or change in Entertainment Audio state ('Tune')
(The HU acts on the knob 2 direction and value pair with the browse, scroll or tune behavior)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The A&T System has exited SLEEP MODE
2. A CAN trace tool is connected and able to log the ICS knob and button status messages
3. The HU shows a list screen on which browse behavior is defined
4. The ICS knob 2 is not being rotated
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the screen currently shown on the HU
2. Rotate the ICS knob 2 one detent position clock-wise
3. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ and check that it is 1 (Knob_increment)
4. Check that the HU acts on the knob 2 rotation as defined for the current screen (expected behavior PENDING: DR-ICS6 <HMI Logic and Flow browse, scroll and tune mapping for ICS_KNOB2>)
tcs.expected_result:
1. The currently shown screen is recorded
2. The knob 2 detent is felt and the rotation is completed
3. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_Knob2_DIR$ = 1 (Knob_increment) is received
4. The HU state differs from the state recorded in step 1
tcs.reasoning: 驗證目標為 4819586：HU 收到 KNOB2 之 DIR／VAL 後確實據以動作（browse／scroll／tune）。上半 33 token，單句逐字全取。**具體動作為何取決於當前畫面**，其對照表在 HMI Logic and Flow（DR-ICS6 未回），指名即造值（IN §8.4.1），故以 `PENDING: DR-ICS6` 佔位並以前後基線比較承載可判定性（同 b02 之 I1／I2 之處置）。條文之 `if any` 明示「可能無對應畫面」—— 故 Pre-Condition 3 限定於「已定義 browse 行為之列表畫面」，否則步驟 4 之斷言即為潛在 FF（IN §7）。與 B1／B5 之別：B1／B5 驗 ICS **送出**面，本條驗 HU **接收後之動作**面 ——二者為不同 ECU 側之行為，非同一觸發之多後果。

distinguishing_axis.delta: HU 接收後之動作面；ICS 之送出面由 B1／B5 承擔

tcs.test_item:
When the HU receives $Enter_Button$ = [pressed] it shall determine the corresponding HMI screen to 'flow' to, if any
(The HU flows to the screen defined for the current context when the Enter button is pressed)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The A&T System has exited SLEEP MODE
2. A CAN trace tool is connected and able to log the ICS knob and button status messages
3. The HU shows a screen on which an Enter action is defined
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the screen currently shown on the HU
2. Press the ICS "Enter" button
3. Read the signal $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_btn1$ and check that it is 1 (Pressed)
4. Check that the HU flows to the screen defined for the current context (target screen PENDING: DR-ICS6 <HMI Logic and Flow screen mapping for Enter_Button>)
tcs.expected_result:
1. The currently shown screen is recorded
2. The "Enter" button enters the pressed state
3. The signal value $CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_btn1$ = 1 (Pressed) is received
4. The screen shown differs from the screen recorded in step 1
tcs.reasoning: 驗證目標為 4819555：HU 收到 `$Enter_Button$` = [pressed] 後流向對應畫面。上半 19 token，單句逐字全取。v2 判定為**適用**（ECU 軸缺、Radio 含 R1L、EE 含 Atlantis High），E3 未觸發。訊號名依 b03 作業 E：`CLIMATIC_PANEL.Radio_btn1`（`BO_ 1050`，節點 ICS，`VAL_ 1050 Radio_btn1 0 "Not_Pressed" 1 "Pressed";`）。目標畫面之對照表在 HMI L&F（DR-ICS6），故佔位。條文之 `if any` 同 4819586 —— Pre-Condition 3 限定於「已定義 Enter 動作之畫面」，否則步驟 4 為潛在 FF。**未涵蓋之覆蓋缺口（E6，具名）**：`1.8.1.3 Button Press Events` 之 Short／Long Press 定義（4819593、4819599 等）於 v2 判**不適用** —— 成因為其 `[ECU:FPDM]` 軸值不含 {ICS, LTM}，屬實質判定而非軸缺。故「按壓事件」之時長判準本 feature 無母條可依，本條只驗 `[pressed]` 訊號值之後果，不涉短按／長按之區別，亦不自他處補（下放包 04 §三 C-4）。

b05_applied: 作業 B：B1／B2 增 PENDING: DR-ICS12 <no-change resend period>（R-ICS23(b)）
b07_applied: 作業 B：符號值佔位回填（R-ICS27(b)(c)），錨增 CFTS020-4819541
